name: Building Footprints
description: Building footprints in Chicago. Metadata may be viewed and downloaded here. This dataset is in a format for spatial datasets that is inherently tabular but allows for a map as a derived view. Please click the indicated link below for such a map. To export the data in either tabular or geographic format, please use the Export button on this dataset.
